features.name: Flask application server
features.detail: Flask on port 8002, NSSM service QI_NayaBot (AppDirectory C:\NAYA). Reconfigures stdout to UTF-8; rotating log at C:\NAYA\LOGS\naya_log.txt (10 MB x 3). Imports naya_db FIRST so maia_db.DB_FILE is patched before any maia_* module loads.

features.name: POST /ask
features.detail: Primary chat endpoint. JSON {message, conv_key?, user_id?}. Calls ask_naya(); saves both turns via db.save_message(); returns {response, conv_key, bot}.

features.name: ask_naya() orchestrator
features.detail: Turn pipeline: due-reminder injection -> help system -> permission/folder-access commands -> LLM intent extraction + action_router.dispatch() -> legacy keyword router (fallback) -> advisor/memory hooks -> NEXUS (if complex+enabled) -> free-form LLM via _llm_call().

features.name: GET /health, /status, /version, /info
features.detail: /health basic liveness; /status returns bot identity + LLM chain labels; /version + /info present for QI ecosystem parity.

features.name: POST /api/action
features.detail: Direct, structured action entry point used by the Gradio File Manager — dispatches into naya_action_router.dispatch_action() without going through chat.

features.name: Telegram long-poll thread
features.detail: Daemon thread calling Telegram getUpdates with 30s long-poll, offset tracking, back-off on error. Restricts replies to naya.telegram_allowed_chat_ids. Janitors sibling-bot NO_OP status leaks. @Naya_qi_bot.

features.name: POST /webhook/peer-bridge
features.detail: HMAC-signed HTTP bridge carrying messages between sibling bots (Tasuke/Maia/Naya) that share a Telegram chat — Telegram refuses direct bot-to-bot delivery. Config from C:\QI\shared-chats.json or the WSL OpenClaw bridge.

features.name: FileHQ engine auto-start
features.detail: Lazily boots the merged FileHQ FastAPI app (filehq.main:app) via uvicorn on internal port 8200 in a daemon thread, the first time a file query needs it.

features.name: LLM chain caller with failover
features.detail: Walks db.get_bot_llm_chain('personal') in priority order. Per-provider branches: anthropic (Anthropic SDK, prompt-cache for >=4096-char system), ollama (POST /v1/chat/completions @127.0.0.1:11434), openrouter/cloudflare (OpenAI-compatible). force_fast promotes local/small models; force_sonnet promotes Anthropic for complex queries.

features.name: Structured intent extraction
features.detail: LLM-first router: sends each message with a schema system prompt and parses a JSON intent {action, target, destination, format, schedule_time, chain_action, confidence}. ~25 actions defined in ACTIONS. Replaces keyword matching as PRIMARY routing.

features.name: Action dispatcher
features.detail: Maps intent action -> handler in _HANDLERS. Permission-gated handlers (_is_approved + _perm_denied). Supports compound chain_action (two actions in one message). Same handlers serve chat, Telegram and the File Manager UI.

features.name: Legacy keyword router (fallback)
features.detail: Regex/keyword intent matching, used only when LLM intent extraction fails entirely, so file commands still work if the model is unreachable.

features.name: NEXUS synthesis routing
features.detail: POSTs {question, context?} to NEXUS :8010 /synthesize, returns merged answer + models-used note. Gated by personal.nexus_enabled (false by default) and _is_complex(); fails closed to the local chain.

features.name: Help system
features.detail: Intercepts 'help' / 'what can you do' / 'how do I...' before the router and returns capability guidance.

features.name: DB redirect shim
features.detail: Sets maia_db.DB_FILE = C:\NAYA\naya.db then re-exports all maia_db symbols (incl. private _conn). Adds Naya overrides save_message()/get_history() keyed on personal.history_enabled / history_limit. Must import before any maia_* module.

features.name: Context builder
features.detail: ctx_builder.build_context(user_id, bot_key='personal') assembles owner persona + facts + history into the system prompt — running against naya.db via the shim.

features.name: Language engine
features.detail: detect_input_language() + build_language_instruction() — langdetect-based; non-English input gets a language directive prepended.

features.name: RAG (removed)
features.detail: maia_rag was removed from Naya's runtime (rag = None, _RAG_AVAILABLE = False) and archived under C:\NAYA\RAG_ARCHIVE\ for Maia reference. No vector store is active in Naya.

features.name: Exact-duplicate scanner
features.detail: Background thread. Phase 1 walk (skips system dirs, <10KB files, A:/B:), Phase 2 group by size, Phase 3 SHA-256 only size-collision candidates, Phase 4 keep groups of 2+. Writes naya_similarity_groups (group_type='exact') with wasted_bytes; updates naya_scans.

features.name: Fuzzy-name scanner
features.detail: difflib-based near-duplicate name matching across drives; stores group_type='fuzzy_name' rows. Scan registry supports parallel + cancellable scans (_is_scan_cancelled).

features.name: SHA-256 helper
features.detail: Chunked (64KB) streaming hash; returns None on any read error so a single unreadable file never aborts a scan.

features.name: USB cross-reference
features.detail: Synchronous, fast: compares a USB drive's home-folder contents against the indexed main drive to flag already-present files.

features.name: Scan results query
features.detail: Reads open groups ordered by wasted_bytes for chat responses and the Naya Brain tab; cancel_active_scan() stops a running scan.

features.name: Cleanup advisor
features.detail: Combines temp/browser/app-cache/recycle-bin scanners with FileHQ index queries (dupes, old-large), ranks candidates by size, persists plans in naya_brain.db. send2trash recycle-bin default; permanent delete only on consent.

features.name: File memory
features.detail: folder_insight summarises a folder from the read-only FileHQ index (cached 24h in naya_folder_insights). capture_intent stores 'I should clean X' statements; reminder_message resurfaces due ones at turn start.

features.name: Safe executor + undo
features.detail: Moves non-keep duplicate members to NAYA_TRASH (never the is_oldest keep copy), logs each batch to naya_brain.db operations; requires personal.file_delete_approved=true; restores from TRASH on undo.

features.name: Permission + folder-access gates
features.detail: Handles 'approve run commands', 'revoke all', 'protect X', 'add X as exception' before the router; folder access tracked in naya_folder_access (naya_brain.db, 16 rows).

features.name: Deferral & scheduling
features.detail: Parses 'not now' / 'tonight' / 'daily at 2am'; saves deferred intents (naya_intents, status='deferred') and creates Windows Task Scheduler tasks under the Naya\ prefix via schtasks.

features.name: Background watchers
features.detail: Three APScheduler-driven services inside the server: disk-space monitor (low_space_threshold_pct/_gb -> Telegram alert), USB watcher (~60s drive-letter poll), off-hours scheduler (quiet-hours + idle detection runs queued heavy jobs).

features.name: Report generator
features.detail: Types: space / dupes / actions / deferred / full. Formats: md, txt, docx (python-docx), pdf (win32com else markdown). Saved to C:\NAYA\REPORTS\.

features.name: Chat tab
features.detail: Browser chat into ask_naya via the Flask API.

features.name: File Manager tab
features.detail: Browse paths and trigger scans/actions through /api/action -> dispatch_action(), without typing commands.

features.name: Naya Brain tab
features.detail: Surfaces scan results, similarity groups, folder insights and the file-intelligence state from naya_brain.db.

features.name: Settings + Logs tabs
features.detail: Edit naya.db config (scan drive, approvals, LLM chain, anthropic mode); tail Naya logs in-browser.

features.name: Knowledge Base tab
features.detail: Knowledge Base tab block is present but commented out (RAG removed); re-enable by uncommenting the gr.Tab block.
